body.name: Exact worst-null calibration
body.construction: Fix \(w\) and enumerate all \(2^{rh}\) assignments \(z\in\{0,1\}^{\mathcal I_r}\). Under the null, parameterize each unit by the two values \(x_{ka,0}=\beta_{ka,1}\) and \(x_{ka,1}=\beta_{ka,1}+\beta_{ka,2}\) in \([-1,1]\), and tabulate the resulting quadratic polynomial \(Q_{r,w}(z;x)\). Introduce threshold \(t\) and boundary-randomization \(u\), enumerate the finitely many strict, equal, and lower sign patterns of \(Q_{r,w}(z;x)-t\), and apply exact quantifier elimination over \(x\in[-1,1]^{2n}\), \(t\), and \(u\) to enforce the worst-null tail-mass inequality. Minimizing \(t\) yields \(c_{\alpha,r}(w)\), and maximizing the feasible \(u\) at that threshold yields \(\gamma_{\alpha,r}(w)\) in \(\phi_{\alpha,r,w}\).
